gallery.description: The one on the left was built to commemorate the Manchuria Telephone and Telegraph Company staff killed in the Tongzhou Uprising in 1937, and the right was built to commemorate cotton-related Japanese victims - at that time, the Japanese troops forced the residents to plant nothing but cotton beside the road.
